docs: The npm typescript package staged into packaged builds.
Pinned by checksum: npm tarballs are immutable per version, so a mismatch
means the registry served something else and the build must stop rather
than ship it. Re-pin deliberately with --update-manifest after reviewing
5.x on purpose. TypeScript 7 is the native Go port, which splits into one
prebuilt binary package per platform and would turn this into a per-target
staging problem; 5.x is pure JavaScript, so one artifact serves every OS.
This is also the line webui/package.json builds against, so the bundled
fallback reports the same diagnostics as a local install.
